svg.text: FAMILY svc_hi rs (svc_hi_dsdv_svc_rs__t1..t6): dsdv_svc_rs regional service slice, H = 16 engine pass
CHAIN S face hbm_i0 (PC r_data 512) -> att HBM service glue -> staging SRAMs (u_stage0/1, top SRAM band)
-> g_tr[k] transposer (provider row k) -> g_t[k] 8 hcores (q.k + p.v, tile row k)
-> scores: every tile -> SX leaf cluster (8 hrows, centre row) -> gather/scatter lanes on E/W/S faces
-> SX tap -> SE assembler -> SM share sml/smd/smr/smc (provider rows) -> P beats back into SX
-> p.v: g_t[k] -> g_m[k] merge pair m4 (provider row k) -> P.V return tree ri/ro -> face
ROLES staging->tr k: FAN-OUT, 1 cycle (one read -> 1060 b fill + 576 b qk to each of 4 tr) | tr k->tile k: P2P
tile k->merge k: P2P fan-in 8:2 | tiles->SX: GATHER (all 32 hc -> one score beat) | SX<->faces:
PASS-THROUGH registered lanes (relays A/B/C, NR=1) | ft0/ft1 E<->W: PASS-THROUGH stations
CRIT (no routed attempt: 14 svc_rs rows held at the 400k cap, so pairs from RTL hop budgets + stations)
1 SX leaf pin -> A -> B -> C -> leaf pin: 4 segments <= 335 um (dsdv_svc_sx header), pins on the
slice centre line at the inner faces of the leaf cluster -> SX row FIXED in the centre slot
2 tile k <-> tr k / merge k one-cycle links at 1.2 GHz (<= 405 um reach) -> provider row ADJACENT to tile k
3 ft station regs (plan ft_slots) -> re-sited by ft_nudge, counts kept
LAYOUT 4 blocks [tile k | provider k] stacked 2 below / 2 above the centred SX row; the provider row of each
block sits on the side of its face landing demand; cores slide in-row only (order kept).
SEARCH fine-tune only: whole identical blocks trade places, provider flips about its own tile, in-row packing;
SX slot / no spread / SX centred are hard constraints (arrange2.intent_ok).
S->N (COORD 03:4x) the SRAM band (staging, land/pmem/pvq capture) is a plan CONTENTS site set (svc_prov v5),
not a hard core: outside this delta. It cannot go to the S face (S carries the attn_i1/attnh_i0/hbm_i0
landing rings, the binding area). PRICE, t2 stock: HBM S->land 512 b x 3.21 mm + 682 b x 3.10 = 3.75k bit-mm
(elastic, credit boundary: relays are free); staging->tr k is ONE cycle SRAM Q -> tr_x flop (w_g 1060 b +
qk_ib 576 b per tr, ot_hdc_v41x_attn_tr_x): 2.15/1.60/0.87/0.31 mm = 8.1k bit-mm, max 2.15 mm = 5.3x the
405 um one-cycle reach -> THE structural critical path of the type, not placement-fixable.
Centre staging strip above SX (rows above shift +56 um, top room 2617 -> 2730): 1.05/0.50/0.54/1.09 mm,
5.2k + 1.4k land->staging write = 6.6k bit-mm (-18%), max 1.09 mm, still 2.7x reach.
FIX pin cycles on staging->tr (w_g/qk_ib, compiled offset, owner lever): 2 stages with the centre strip or
5 with the N band -> S81-SVCRS-3 RTL + DIE-S81-85 SRAM sites, next svc event (not the 12:00 cut).
arrows: green dashed staging->tr (broadcast), green tr->tile (p2p), orange tile->merge (p.v p2p), red tile->SX (score gather), red dashed SX to and from faces (relayed lanes)
